curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach how to meet, turn near, cross behind, pass and be passed by commercial vehicles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each commercial-vehicle rule with contrasts on sides and merge timing.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on passing and turning near rigs.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover yielding to emergency vehicles and to funeral processions.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on what to do when sirens approach or a procession passes.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach where carts may go, who may drive them, their hours, crossings, sidewalks and required equipment.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each cart rule with the key numbers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on cart drivers, crossings and equipment.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover low-speed vehicle speeds, streets and equipment, and motorcycle lane rights.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for low-speed vehicle limits and motorcycle rights.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on low-speed vehicles and lane splitting.
